page_title: FUL 0-1 NEW | Fulham v Newcastle 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' The match has just finished.
90+10' Samuel Allison couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Raul Jimenez (Fulham) and blew his whistle.
90+10' The ball rebounds to Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
90+10' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Bernd Leno.
90+8' Fulham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+8' Fulham are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fulham.
90+6' Harry Wilson (Fulham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
90+6' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+5' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Lewis Hall is replaced by Paul Dummett (Newcastle Utd).
90+5' A substitution has been made. Anthony Gordon goes off and Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd) comes on.

90+4' The game is pretty dull as Fulham are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. Now Fulham have a corner.
90+3' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+3' Fulham are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fulham.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
88' The resulting set piece from Fulham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
88' Fulham spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake. Fulham win a corner.
85' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Raul Jimenez (Fulham) replacing Rodrigo Muniz.
85' Substitution. Armando Broja (Fulham) in, Joao Palhinha out.
85' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
83' Harry Wilson (Fulham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

81' 0 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Bernd Leno. 0:1.
80' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Samuel Allison who sees an offensive foul.
78' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Newcastle due to a foul in the build-up play.
77' The Newcastle players halt their celebrations as referee Samuel Allison makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
75' Goal! Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Newcastle comes to nothing.

75' Newcastle are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. The ball goes behind for a corner. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
73' A corner kick by Fulham is thwarted by the well prepared Martin Dubravka (Newcastle Utd).
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham. Fulham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

73' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Fulham.
68' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
68' Newcastle take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Newcastle have a corner.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tom Cairney departs the field of play to be replaced by Sasa Lukic (Fulham).
65' Substitution. Andreas Pereira walks off the pitch and Adama Traore (Fulham) comes on as a substitute.
65' Here is a change. Willian is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Harry Wilson (Fulham).
65' Today's match ends for Jacob Murphy who will be replaced by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
64' Newcastle take a short corner kick.
64' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Newcastle will take a corner kick.
63' Shots on target – 4:2.
60' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is out of play. Fulham will take a throw-in.
54' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is able to continue to play.
52' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
51' Samuel Allison shows the yellow card to Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) for a heavy challenge.
49' Fulham players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45+3' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
45+2' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) tries to find Willian, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' A cross is whipped into the box by Joao Palhinha (Fulham) and Rodrigo Muniz controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
44' Martin Dubravka displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Tom Cairney (Fulham) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
42' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) offside.
40' Eddie Howe is forced to make a change. Joe Willock is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd).

39' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Martin Dubravka, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
39' Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) brings an opponent down and Samuel Allison interrupts the game.

38' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.

35' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.

34' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
33' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) forces a pass into the box, but Bernd Leno is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
33' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross in and finds Jacob Murphy inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
31' Martin Dubravka (Newcastle Utd) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
29' The game is interrupted now, Martin Dubravka (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Tom Cairney (Fulham) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Martin Dubravka.
28' Samuel Allison blows his whistle. Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul after dangerous play.
27' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul and Samuel Allison immediately signals a free kick.
27' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Martin Dubravka comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' Martin Dubravka (Newcastle Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
22' Martin Dubravka (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
21' Fulham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
21' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Fulham are going to take it.
20' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
19' Samuel Allison shows a yellow card to Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) for his blatant foul.
18' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

18' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Martin Dubravka pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom left corner.
17' The resulting corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
16' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.

15' That was close by Joao Palhinha (Fulham)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
14' Martin Dubravka comes off his line to intercept the corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham).
14' A lofted cross from Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee signals a corner kick to Fulham.
13' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

11' Willian (Fulham) holds his head in his hands after missing a big chance. He latches on to a rebound, creates some space from himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
11' Willian (Fulham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
10' A rebound sits up perfectly for Tom Cairney (Fulham), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
10' Willian (Fulham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
8' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Willian (Fulham) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
7' Good defending. Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) tries to find Alexander Isak inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
5' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
5' Tom Cairney (Fulham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Fulham get a corner.
5' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
4' Fulham are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. Corner kick. Fulham will have an opportunity.
4' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
3' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
2' Fulham string together a series of short passes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Fulham will kick the game off.
Samuel Allison is the one to supervise the game today.
